entries.name: On Me
entries.headline: Bill idhar.
entries.story: The conversation is still going. Someone orders one more round. You catch the server’s eye and reach for the bill. No announcement. Just a small, certain gesture: this one’s on me.

entries.name: Brainwave
entries.headline: Haan, mera idea hai.
entries.short_description: Cobalt blue, pearly white and silver-toned shine.
entries.story: It began as a sketch in the margin: a crescent-shaped bag, a better curve, a detail you couldn’t leave alone. You tried it. Changed it. Made it real. When someone asks whose idea it is, you know exactly what to say.

entries.name: Diet Cherry
entries.headline: Haan, wohi wali.
entries.short_description: Deep red, blush and silver-toned accents.
entries.story: A new place. A familiar face across the table. Before the menu reaches you, your friend asks if it’s the usual. You smile. Some favourites travel with you, wherever the evening goes.

entries.name: Green Flag
entries.headline: Tum aa jao. Main dekh lungi.
entries.short_description: Emerald green and blush, with pointed green tips.
entries.story: The plan falls apart. Your phone rings. There’s no perfect itinerary, no carefully set table. You move a chair, make a little room and say the thing your friend needed to hear: come over. We’ll figure out the rest.

entries.name: Shaadi Shift
entries.headline: Dulhan tu. Duty meri.
entries.short_description: Pink and deep red, with a little yellow flower.
entries.story: One missing safety pin. One last adjustment. One look that says, stay close. You’re there for the tiny things between the big moments, keeping her laughing while the room gets louder. Her big day. Your very familiar role.

entries.name: Wild Card
entries.headline: Achha. Tum pehle.
entries.short_description: Acid lime, blush and cobalt-and-white checks.
entries.story: Your cards face you. Your smile gives nothing away. Across the table, someone is feeling very confident. You let them take their turn, quietly hoping the next card goes your way. The fun is in what happens next.

entries.name: Pinky Promise
entries.headline: Haath do. Main hoon.
entries.short_description: Lilac with deep burgundy, asymmetric pointed tips.
entries.story: The room is crowded. Everyone seems to know where to go. Then a familiar hand reaches back for yours. No big speech. Just a small reminder that you don’t have to find your way through alone.
